category.desc: One of the skill categories. Send an empty string to clear. _Acceptable values:_ `communication` `customer_support` `data_and_analytics` `engineering` `product_management` `productivity` `professional_development` `project_management` `sales` `system` `team_management` `other`

description.desc: When Slackbot should use the skill. Max 400 characters. Send an empty string to clear.

example_prompt.desc: Max 200 characters. May contain `{skill}`. Send an empty string to clear.

instructions.desc: Markdown that replaces the whole document. Sending `instructions` replaces the whole document, and sending `mcp_servers` replaces the whole list.

mcp_servers.desc: Apps the skill needs. Replaces the whole list; send `[]` to clear. Sending `instructions` replaces the whole document, and sending `mcp_servers` replaces the whole list.

desc: Changes a Slackbot skill's instructions or metadata. Only the inputs you send are changed; a call that changes nothing succeeds without writing.

errors.canvas_editing_failed: The skill's instructions or display name couldn't be saved.
errors.canvas_editing_locked: Another edit to the skill is in progress. Retry the request.
errors.feature_not_enabled: The Skills API isn't enabled for this organization.
errors.invalid_category: `category` isn't one of the skill categories.
errors.mcp_server_not_found: One or more declared apps don't exist or aren't available to the caller. `invalid_mcp_servers` lists them.
errors.method_not_supported_for_skill_type: Only canvas skills can be changed.
errors.restricted_action: The caller isn't allowed to change this skill.
errors.skill_not_found: The skill doesn't exist or the caller can't see it.
errors.too_many_mcp_servers: More apps were declared than the caller can enable at once.
